proposals.name: Sterile Processing Technicians (SPD / Central Sterile)
proposals.buyer_persona: Certified Registered Central Service Technicians (CRCST) who sterilize surgical instruments. They feel invisible compared to nurses, have strong insider humor about dirty bone mallets, bioburden, and autoclave cycles.
product_angles: Sarcastic autoclave & decontamination-themed stickers for water bottles (Redbubble)
KDP CRCST exam study planners and daily instrument tracking logbooks
Funny SVG cutting files for badge reels and custom scrub jackets
proposals.first_test_product: The Ultimate Sterile Processing Technical Log & Shift Tracker (KDP)

proposals.name: Retro PSX / Low-Poly Gamedev 3D Assets
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building horror or retro games mimicking 1990s PlayStation 1 aesthetics. They need hyper-optimized, low-texture-budget models and modular assets.
product_angles: Low-poly retro dungeon/corridor modular tilesets (OBJ/FBX format)
Y2K-era low-fidelity prop packs (CRT TVs, payphones, old computers)
Cults3D printable retro console shell replacements or miniature dioramas
proposals.first_test_product: PSX-Style Retro Mall Prop Pack (30 modular FBX assets + low-res textures)

proposals.name: Ham Radio (Amateur Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Highly technical hobbyists, often older but extremely passionate about global radio propagation, Morse code, and tracking their contacts (QSO). They love physical logs and custom equipment.
product_angles: Ham Radio Operator Log Book with specialized fields (Frequency, Mode, Power, RST, QSL)
Redbubble t-shirts with humor about antenna tuning, SWR, and Morse code
SVG vector designs of classic radio towers and patent drawings for custom shack signs
proposals.first_test_product: Amateur Radio QSO Contact Log Book (KDP, custom interior grid)

proposals.name: French Regional GR Hiking Trails (Sentiers de Grande Randonnée)
proposals.buyer_persona: Avid French hikers and international tourists completing specific routes (GR20, GR34, Saint-Jacques). They want memorabilia, planning journals, and local pride items.
product_angles: Vintage travel poster style designs of iconic GR34 lighthouses (Redbubble / Displate style)
KDP Hiking journal tailored specifically to the GR20 with packing lists and stage logs
SVG designs of trail markers and regional pride slogans for local decors
proposals.first_test_product: Carnet de Randonnée GR34 - Breton Coast Trail Planner & Logbook (KDP)

proposals.name: Solo Board Gamers (1-Player Board Games)
proposals.buyer_persona: Enthusiasts who play complex tabletop games alone. They track high scores, campaign progressions, and require physical organization systems for small play spaces.
product_angles: KDP Solo Board Game Campaign Journal & Session Log
Cults3D parametric card holders and universal token trays optimized for small desks
Redbubble apparel with insider jokes ('Autonomous AI Opponent Destroyer')
proposals.first_test_product: Modular Stackable Token Tray & Card Holder STL Pack (Cults3D)

proposals.name: Land Surveyors (Géomètres)
proposals.buyer_persona: Outdoor professionals who combine precise mathematics, legal boundaries, and heavy equipment (theodolites, GPS). They take massive pride in mapping the physical world.
product_angles: Technical humor t-shirts ('Trust me, I'm a Land Surveyor' with transit level schematics)
KDP weatherproof style Field Book grid templates for site measurements
SVGs of classic surveying tools for custom laser-engraved gifts
proposals.first_test_product: Professional Land Surveyor Field Notes Book (KDP, 5x5 grid left, ruled right)

proposals.name: Model Miniature Painters (Warhammer/DnD Minis)
proposals.buyer_persona: Hobbyists spending hours painting 28mm miniatures. They struggle with paint bottle organization (Vallejo vs Citadel sizes) and tracking color recipes/paint backlog.
product_angles: Cults3D parametric wall-mounted modular paint racks (custom fits)
KDP Miniatures Paint Project Planner & Color Recipe Journal
Redbubble stickers mocking the 'Pile of Shame' (unpainted minis)
